B2B business onboarding

Medical shop registration

The Connect Pharma is intended for pharmaceutical businesses. Medical shop account creation is limited to the retailer role. After email verification, submit a current retail Drug Licence and GST certificate through KYC for manual administrative review.

Email verification is not business verification. Document review does not certify a licence with a government registry or replace your legal obligations. Buyers are responsible for maintaining the required authorisations and records and must not obtain Schedule H, H1, X or other regulated medicines without the required authority.
